account.title: Who plays?
account.notVerified: {{ name }} is locked to other sign-ins. You are signed in with another sign-in, so you cannot play with it. Sign in with the right one, or use a link code.
account.startHelp: Type your name and press the button: you make a new account that is open to anyone. You can lock it later with a sign-in.
account.sameName: There is already someone called {{ name }}. Is that you?
account.sameNames: There are {{ count }} people called {{ name }}. Which one is you?
account.noneOfThem: None of them, make a new account
account.notOnList: Not on the list and have no account?
account.pressName: Press your name to play as you.
account.chooseHelp: Press your account to play. A lock means you must sign in first.
account.userActionsHelp: Here you change your alias, your account name, your picture and your language. Choose another account switches to somebody else: your rounds and jigsaws stay yours.
account.openWarning: This account is not verified. Anybody who knows its alias can play as it, change it or delete it. Sign in and lock it to make it yours.

edit.usernameFree: Free: nobody else has this alias.
edit.usernameTaken: Taken: somebody else has this alias.
edit.usernameHelpEdit: {{ min }} to {{ max }} characters. Nobody else can have the same. Your rounds stay yours when you change it.
edit.pictureFailed: That file could not be used as a picture.
edit.pictureHelp: A small picture shown with your account. It is cut square and made small.
edit.languageHelp: The language the app is shown in for you, and the default language for the names and descriptions of your jigsaws.

hiddenHelp: Hidden: the picture is removed from the home page.

picture.couldNotMake: Could not save the picture. Nothing was saved: check the picture and try again.
picture.couldNotRead: Could not read the picture: try again.
picture.couldNotChange: Could not save the changes: only the owner can change a picture, and not its picture once rounds have been played.
picture.couldNotDelete: Could not delete the picture: only its owner can.

puzzelLogon: Log on to put the puzzle together.
puzzelChoose: Choosing the number of pieces comes next.
roundsFailed: Could not read the rounds: try again.
noPictureRounds: No rounds have been played of this picture yet.
notYours: This picture is not yours: you can look at it, but not change it.
hasRounds: Rounds have been played of this picture: its picture, size and cut can not be changed. The rest can.
noFavorites: You have no favorites yet: press the heart on a picture.
howToPlay: Press a picture to start a round. The pieces are scattered round the picture: drag them to where they belong, and pieces that fit click together. Everything is saved by itself, so you can stop and come back any time. The menu has a help picture, the details of the round and the border pieces to help you.
howHome: The logo with the little house at the top of the menu takes you home, to the pictures: press the logo here and you go there. The arrow beside it folds the menu away and opens it again.
howMenu: The menu floats over the page: drag it to where it is out of the way. It changes with the page you are on.
howDock: Drag the menu to any edge of the window and it stays there as a bar. Drag it away to let it float again.
toCorner: Fold the menu into the top right corner
howCorner: The little arrow at the right end of the top row of the menu (or a double click on that row) folds the menu and places it in the top right corner of the window.

feed.intro: You write in one language and the AI translates the others when you save. It is shown from the day you say until the day it expires.
feed.deleteFailed: Could not delete it: only the one who wrote it can.
feed.loadFailed: Could not read the list: try again.
feed.notFound: This does not exist, or it is not yours.
feed.masterHelp: The AI makes the other languages when you save.
feed.labelHelp: A short mark on the offer, for example -20 %.
feed.linkHelp: Starts with https://. An offer leads to a link or to a page in the app.
feed.datesHelp: Leave a date empty for no limit.
feed.tUnavailable: The AI could not be asked, so the other languages are missing for now: save again later.
feed.tFailed: The translation failed: save again later.
feed.noPictures: No pictures in this package yet.
feed.deletePackageAsk: Delete this package and its {{ count }} pictures for good?
feed.picturesIntro: The pictures you add here belong to the package. They are public and are not in the general list.
feed.privateBanner: Private: only you see this. Make it public when it is ready.
feed.visibilityHelp: Public: everybody sees it. Private: only you see it, with a banner on it, so you can check how it looks. Hidden: it is not shown on the home page.
feed.getFailed: Could not add the package: try again.
feed.lockedHint: Add the package to my pictures to play them.
feed.logOnToGet: Log on to add it to my pictures
